title: kv-cache: adaptive memory manager and spillover scheduling to reduce fragmentation and paging
author: Aisha Kumar
description: Motivation: on high-concurrency workloads we observed KV cache fragmentation and frequent paging/spillover under headroom pressure which increased token latency and GPU memory churn. This PR implements an adaptive KV cache memory manager and spillover scheduler to reduce fragmentation, defer paging, and compact hot prefixes proactively. Changes include a lightweight background compactor, a prioritized eviction queue that biases by live-prefix contiguity and recent access patterns, a spillover scheduler that prefers remote spill lanes under transient pressure, and tighter integration with the continuous batching scheduler so we avoid IO during hot-batch tails. Outcomes: 20-35% reduction in page-faults for long-lived conversation workloads, 12-18% tail-latency improvement at p95 for multi-tenant hosts, and 8-10% lower token-cost due to reduced re-computation. Backwards compatibility: behavior is guarded behind runtime config flags and defaults to the previous manager; can be enabled per-deployment and rolled out via canary. Testing and rollout: unit + integration coverage added, benchmark harness updated, staged canary rollout plan with automatic rollback on perf regressions. See linked Linear items for follow-up monitoring and telemetry enhancements.

Author (Aisha Kumar): Fixed shutdown race by observing node_state in worker and added a test to validate graceful drain behavior.
Sara Li: CI integration flakes in the spillover test on ARM builders - suggested increasing timeouts and adding a retry for transient network pulls.

release_notes: Adaptive KV cache memory manager: reduces fragmentation, schedules spillover to remote lanes under transient pressure, and introduces background compaction to improve tail latency and reduce paging. Feature disabled by default and gated for staged rollout.
notes_for_release: Enable via kv_cache.experimental.adaptive_manager=true in canary clusters. Monitor kv_cache.compaction_io and kv_cache.page_faults. Rollback plan: disable the flag to return to the previous manager behavior.
observability_changes: Added metrics: kv_cache.compaction_runs, kv_cache.compaction_bytes_moved, kv_cache.spillover_scheduled, kv_cache.eviction_contiguity_score; added dashboards and alerts for sustained compaction IO and page-fault regressions.
perf_results: Benchmarks ran on p4d-like instance: 20-35% fewer page-faults on long-lived chat workloads; p95 latency improved 12-18% under 75% load; token-cost reduction 8-10% for conversational rerank-heavy traffic.
